final: WITH s AS (SELECT si.zoneregistry AS z, si.insurstat AS st, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / m.geomdeltamm) AS r, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = m.zoneref WHERE si.insurstat IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(si.insurstat) <> '' GROUP BY si.zoneregistry, si.insurstat HAVING r IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT st, AVG(r) AS avg_r FROM s GROUP BY st), k AS (SELECT s.st, s.r, s.n, a.avg_r FROM s JOIN a ON a.st = s.st WHERE s.r > a.avg_r) SELECT st AS insurstat, AVG(r) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(n) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(r - avg_r) AS avg_excess FROM k GROUP BY st
